en_US: Hi! My name is Steven Stone.
The Champion from the Hoenn Region.
I’m interested in rare stones,
so I travel here and there.
The Oreburgh Mine sometimes discovers
rare stones while they mine for coal.
I wanted to be here to see any
discoveries they make in person.
Oh! You have a Pokédex.
So you are also in search of Pokémon.
Let me see...
I think I can help you with that.
Steven: This is my favourite Pokémon.
Its name is BELDUM.
Would you be willing to raise it?
It’ll be useful for your Pokédex.
Steven: Hmm. Your party is full.
Why don’t you go to the PC to make
some room?
Steven: Are you sure?
Perhaps you are quite cautious...
Do you want to give a nickname to
this BELDUM?
Steven: Take good care of it.
Your caring for it will make me
very happy.
Now, if you want to talk about stones...
Please come and talk to me at any time.
Steven: Ah, we meet again!
What did you want to talk about?
Steven: Have you been to Hoenn before?
It’s such a beautiful place, with the
clearest ocean you can imagine.
There’s lots of places to excavate
rare stones from, too.
For example, there is a place called
Granite Cave, on a small island...
I once met a young Trainer much like
yourself at that cave, in fact.
Steven: The BELDUM I gave to you is
an example of a Steel-type Pokémon.
That particular texture!
The cool and glowing bodies!
Such uniquenesses are only for the
amazing Steel-type Pokémon!
My METAGROSS is truly strong and cool!
Nothing else comes close!
Steven: Have you heard of a place
called the Unova region before?
There’s a place called Driftveil City
where you can mine emeralds.
I’d love to visit there.
If only I had a good excuse...
Steven: Do you know of Alola?
It’s a tropical region, like Hoenn.
Over in Alola, they wield a unique power
known as Z-moves, using a Z-Ring.
A Z-ring is a bracelet made by refining
something called a Sparkling Stone.
I would love to see a Sparkling Stone.
But they’re hard to come by.
Steven: I recently gave up a villa that
I owned on Sinnoh’s Battle Zone island.
It was quite a nice place, actually.
But it was a bit too far away...
Steven: There’s a particular stone
in Sinnoh that I’m interested in...
Have you heard of the Magma Stone?
It’s a big, red stone formed by rocks
melting in intensely hot magma.
Legends say that the stone is able to
control a legendary Pokémon, too.
It’s meant to be one-of-a-kind.
I’d love to see it.
Steven: That rock you have there...
That’s the Magma Stone, isn’t it?!
You’ve captured the Pokémon it was
meant to control? Very impressive.
In that case...
I would very much appreciate some
time to inspect that Magma Stone.
Steven: Let me share an equally
valuable stone with you.
Behold this beautiful gem.
This is the Soul Dew!
Steven: Have you heard of the two
Pokémon called LATIAS and LATIOS?
The Soul Dew is said to be the spirits
of these two Pokémon, solidified.
The spirits of these Pokémon and the
Soul Dew are said to call out to
one another...
LATIAS and LATIOS make their home in a
place known as Southern Island.
But that’s in the Hoenn region...
And this is Sinnoh...
Does Sinnoh have any secluded islands
you could take the Soul Dew to?
It might be worth a try if you want to
complete that Pokédex of yours.
If you do manage to capture both of
those Pokémon, show them to me.
Steven: That’s LATIAS and LATIOS in
your party, isn’t it?!
Very impressive. You really are the
real deal, young Trainer!
In that case, I have another request.
Steven: Have you heard of the Pokémon
known as the legendary titans?
REGIROCK, REGICE and REGISTEEL.
A Rock-type, Ice-type and Steel-type.
I’ve had reports that these three
Pokémon may be sleeping in Sinnoh.
They would likely be sleeping in
caverns throughout the region.
Though they won’t be easy to find.
You may need to fulfil a condition...
I seem to remember an old reading
about RELICANTH and WAILORD.
Maybe you should visit places with
those Pokémon in your party?
Please show me the legendary titans.
I’ll have a reward waiting for you.
Steven: Ah, yes, that’s them.
The legendary titans!
You truly are a legendary Trainer.
In every sense of the word.
Your REGISTEEL in particular...
It’s very beautiful, isn’t it?
As promised, here’s a reward.
The ancient artifacts of Hoenn!
Steven: In Hoenn, legends say the
battle between GROUDON and KYOGRE
is what shaped the lands and seas.
But then the Pokémon that rules the
skies, known as RAYQUAZA, came down
and halted the battle.
Each of those Orbs I gave you has a
connection with one of those Pokémon.
Perhaps fate will allow you to meet
them for yourself.
Hmm...
An underground cave, filled with a
large amount of water...
A heated mountain, surrounded by
lava and molten rock...
A place that stretches into the sky,
where only powerful Trainers gather...
If you were to visit places like that...
You may just be able to find them.
Steven: Thank you for all of your help
in satisfying my unusual requests.
Oh, I never got your name, did I?
...But I won’t ask for it this time.
Our fun will have to wait for the
right time.
Steven: A battle?
I won’t deny that you’re a very
interesting Trainer.
Sadly, as you are now...
You wouldn’t stand a chance.
Steven: A battle?
With the Champion of the Sinnoh region?
I’ll gladly accept such an offer.
If you’re going to mount a serious
challenge...
Prepare for the worst!
Steven: You...
You’ve become very strong.
Fufufu.
I hope we can battle again.
